title: Breaking: Air Quality Worsens Across California as AQI Hits Unhealthy Levels
description: Several California cities are reporting deteriorating air quality today as PM2.5 pollution pushes AQI levels into poor and unhealthy categories.

pages.title: California Air Quality Alert
pages.description: Air quality has sharply declined across parts of California today. Multiple cities are now reporting poor to unhealthy AQI levels.

pages.title: What’s Causing the Decline?
pages.description: Fine particle pollution, known as PM2.5, is driving today’s air quality concerns. These tiny particles can penetrate deep into the lungs and affect health.

pages.title: Carmichael
pages.description: Carmichael is reporting an AQI of 155 today. Air quality is unhealthy, and residents are advised to limit outdoor exposure.

pages.title: Alameda
pages.description: With an AQI of 67, air quality in Alameda remains moderate. Most people are safe outdoors, but sensitive individuals should stay cautious.

pages.title: Milpitas
pages.description: Milpitas has recorded an AQI of 116, signaling poor air quality. People with respiratory conditions may experience breathing discomfort.

pages.title: Newport Beach
pages.description: Newport Beach is seeing an AQI of 134 today. Air quality is poor, and outdoor activities should be reduced.

pages.title: Perris
pages.description: Perris has entered the unhealthy category with an AQI of 162. Health impacts are more likely, especially for vulnerable groups.

pages.title: Mission Viejo
pages.description: Mission Viejo is reporting an AQI of 137. Poor air quality may cause irritation during prolonged outdoor activity.

pages.title: San Marcos
pages.description: San Marcos has reached an AQI of 153 today. Extended exposure could affect everyone, not just sensitive groups.

pages.title: Jurupa Valley
pages.description: Jurupa Valley is among the worst affected with an AQI of 167. Residents are urged to avoid outdoor exercise.

pages.title: Torrance
pages.description: Torrance is currently at an AQI of 98. Air quality is moderate, but conditions could change quickly.

pages.title: Corona
pages.description: Corona is also reporting unhealthy air with an AQI of 167. Reducing time spent outdoors is strongly recommended.

pages.title: Health Advisory
pages.description: Officials advise residents to stay indoors when possible. Keep windows closed, use air purifiers, and follow local air quality alerts.
